name: Frame Window Counter
description: Counts the frame window (and FP, like 120 FP) of every input in an xdBot or Eclipse macro.

survive-ticks.name: Survive Ticks
survive-ticks.description: How many ticks the player has to survive after a shifted input for it to count as a pass. 240 is one second at 240 TPS.

max-search.name: Max Search (ticks)
max-search.description: How far an input is shifted in each direction while searching for its window. Windows wider than this show a <cy>+</c>.

count-releases.name: Count Releases
count-releases.description: Also count the window of release inputs, not only presses. Takes about twice as long.
